result.summary: Found 3 issues related to layout and content truncation in a food delivery app interface.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third item 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off abruptly at the right edge, showing truncated text and a partially visible card without proper edge treatment.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel items either fully display or show a clear partial-peek pattern with consistent spacing, and truncate restaurant names with an ellipsis in a controlled way rather than clipping mid-word.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are inconsistent between cards. The Tokumaru Ramen card shows a white heart on dark background while the pizza card shows a heart in a dark circular background, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon styling across all restaurant cards for a consistent look and predictable interaction.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card ('Popular right now' second item) is heavily cut off by the bottom navigation bar, showing only the image without its title, rating, or details.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content area so cards are not obscured by the fixed navigation bar, or ensure the next card starts fully below the fold.
